knowledge:
- key_parameters: half=logical indicating whether to set TGS values smaller than 0.5 to 0.5 ;; normalize=logical indicating whether to apply quantile normalization in rmaMicroRna ;; background=logical indicating whether to apply background correction in rmaMicroRna ;; control=logical indicating whether to filter out control features ;; IsGeneDetected=logical indicating whether to filter by the gIsGeneDetected flag ;; limIsGeneDetected=numeric threshold percentage for gene detection across samples ;; DEmethod=character string specifying the method to select differentially expressed genes ("separate" or "nestedF") ;; MTestmethod=character string specifying the multiple testing correction method (e.g., "BH")
- alternatives: TGS protocol (tgsMicroRna followed by tgsNormalization) vs. RMA protocol (rmaMicroRna) for signal estimation and normalization ;; direct use of limma functions (lmFit, contrasts.fit, eBayes) vs. the basicLimma wrapper
- when_to_use: When analyzing Agilent microRNA microarray data exported by Agilent Feature Extraction (AFE) software, particularly when quality control, probe filtering, and linear modeling of experimental designs are required.
- pitfalls: Missing columns in input files will cause readMicroRnaAFE to fail, requiring manual calls to read.agiMicroRna to exclude missing columns ;; Negative values in TGS must be handled using the half=TRUE or offset options to avoid log-transformation errors ;; Hierarchical clustering may show random noise instead of experimental groups if the percentage of differentially expressed genes is very low.

workflows.name: agilent_tgs_workflow
workflows.intent: Process Agilent microRNA data using the Total Gene Signal (TGS) protocol, followed by quantile normalization, filtering, and differential expression analysis.
input: targets.txt (tab-delimited target file specifying FileName, Treatment, GErep, and Subject)
mscA1.txt (Agilent Feature Extraction scanned data file)
workflows.stages: 1. Load target file and read Agilent Feature Extraction data ;; 2. Perform quality control plotting and array reproducibility assessment ;; 3. Extract Total Gene Signal (TGS) and normalize between arrays ;; 4. Filter out low-quality probes and controls ;; 5. Create an ExpressionSet object ;; 6. Fit linear models and define contrast matrices using limma ;; 7. Select significant microRNAs and output results.
workflows.code:
library("AgiMicroRna")
data(targets.micro)
print(targets.micro)
data(dd.micro)
class(dd.micro)
dim(dd.micro)
print(names(dd.micro))
qcPlots(dd.micro,offset=5,
        MeanSignal=TRUE,
        ProcessedSignal=FALSE,
        TotalProbeSignal=FALSE,
        TotalGeneSignal=FALSE,
        BGMedianSignal=FALSE,
        BGUsed=FALSE,
        targets.micro)
boxplotMicroRna(log2(dd.micro$meanS),
	maintitle='log2 Mean Signal',
	colorfill= 'orange')
plotDensityMicroRna(log2(dd.micro$meanS),
	maintitle='log2 Mean Signal')
ddaux=dd.micro
ddaux$G=log2(dd.micro$meanS)
mvaMicroRna(ddaux,
	maintitle='log2 Mean Signal',
	verbose=FALSE)
rm(ddaux)
RleMicroRna(log2(dd.micro$meanS),
	maintitle='log2 Mean Signal - RLE')
hierclusMicroRna(log2(dd.micro$meanS),targets.micro$GErep,
		methdis="euclidean",
                methclu="complete",
		sel=TRUE,100)
cvArray(dd.micro,
        "MeanSignal",
        targets.micro,
	verbose=TRUE)
ddTGS=tgsMicroRna(dd.micro,
    half=TRUE,
    makePLOT=FALSE,
    verbose=FALSE)
ddNORM=tgsNormalization(ddTGS,
                "quantile",
                makePLOTpre=FALSE,
                makePLOTpost=FALSE,
                targets.micro,
		verbose=TRUE)
ddPROC=filterMicroRna(ddNORM,
                    dd.micro,
                    control=TRUE,
                    IsGeneDetected=TRUE,
                    wellaboveNEG=FALSE,
                    limIsGeneDetected=75,
                    limNEG=25,
                    makePLOT=FALSE,
                    targets.micro,
		    verbose=TRUE,
                    writeout=FALSE)
esetPROC=esetMicroRna(ddPROC,
          targets.micro,
          makePLOT=FALSE,
	  verbose=TRUE)
levels.treatment=levels(factor(targets.micro$Treatment))
        treatment=factor(as.character(targets.micro$Treatment),
                levels=levels.treatment)
levels.subject=levels(factor(targets.micro$Subject))
        subject=factor(as.character(targets.micro$Subject),
                levels=levels.subject)
design=model.matrix(~ -1 + treatment + subject)
print(design)
fit=lmFit(esetPROC,design)
names(fit)
print(head(fit$coeff))
CM=cbind(MSC_AvsMSC_B=c(1,-1,0,0),
        MSC_AvsMSC_C=c(1,0,-1,0))
print(CM)
fit2=contrasts.fit(fit,CM)
names(fit2)
print(head(fit2$coeff))
fit2=eBayes(fit2)
names(fit2)
DE=getDecideTests(fit2,
        DEmethod="separate",
        MTestmethod="BH",
        PVcut=0.10,
	verbose=TRUE)

workflows.name: agilent_rma_workflow
workflows.intent: Process Agilent microRNA data using the Robust Multiarray Average (RMA) protocol, followed by filtering and differential expression analysis.
input: targets.txt (tab-delimited target file specifying FileName, Treatment, GErep, and Subject)
mscA1.txt (Agilent Feature Extraction scanned data file)
workflows.stages: 1. Load target file and read Agilent Feature Extraction data ;; 2. Perform quality control plotting and array reproducibility assessment ;; 3. Estimate normalized gene signal using the RMA algorithm ;; 4. Filter out low-quality probes and controls ;; 5. Create an ExpressionSet object ;; 6. Fit linear models and define contrast matrices using limma ;; 7. Select significant microRNAs and output results.
workflows.code:
library("AgiMicroRna")
data(targets.micro)
data(dd.micro)
ddTGS.rma=rmaMicroRna(dd.micro,
		normalize=TRUE,
		background=TRUE)
ddPROC=filterMicroRna(ddTGS.rma,
                    dd.micro,
                    control=TRUE,
                    IsGeneDetected=TRUE,
                    wellaboveNEG=FALSE,
                    limIsGeneDetected=75,
                    limNEG=25,
                    makePLOT=FALSE,
                    targets.micro,
		    verbose=TRUE,
                    writeout=FALSE)
esetPROC=esetMicroRna(ddPROC,
          targets.micro,
          makePLOT=FALSE,
	  verbose=TRUE)
levels.treatment=levels(factor(targets.micro$Treatment))
        treatment=factor(as.character(targets.micro$Treatment),
                levels=levels.treatment)
levels.subject=levels(factor(targets.micro$Subject))
        subject=factor(as.character(targets.micro$Subject),
                levels=levels.subject)
design=model.matrix(~ -1 + treatment + subject)
fit=lmFit(esetPROC,design)
CM=cbind(MSC_AvsMSC_B=c(1,-1,0,0),
        MSC_AvsMSC_C=c(1,0,-1,0))
fit2=contrasts.fit(fit,CM)
fit2=eBayes(fit2)
DE=getDecideTests(fit2,
        DEmethod="separate",
        MTestmethod="BH",
        PVcut=0.10,
	verbose=TRUE)
